content: Modern SaaS appearance panels (Vercel/Linear/Notion-style) standardize on: a small set of theme presets (not open color pickers) exposed as swatch/preview cards; light/dark as first-class variants rather than a bolt-on; semantic token layer (e.g. --color-brand-primary) that remaps per theme so components never hardcode colors; preference persisted server-side (account/settings) not just localStorage so it's consistent across devices. Accent colors are used sparingly against a neutral base to avoid overwhelming dark UIs.
